description: Corrects an opportunity's content: label, description, priority, what done means, the 1–5 value / feasibility / risk scores, the owner (a PERSON page), notes, tags, workflow anchor, external link, visibility. Fields you omit are untouched; the lane is NOT here — move it with compass_opportunities_set_status. Opportunity ids come from compass_opportunities_list. May return `needs_confirmation` — say what you're changing and wait.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response, after the user has approved. Omit on the first call.

assignee.description: The workspace member doing the work, by email or user id; null unassigns. They're notified.

doneWhen.description: What's true when it's done, that someone else could check (≤1,000 chars).

experiment.description: Measure it against the Ledger (expectation when it starts, verdict when it's done).

externalUrl.description: Where the doing happens off-platform (URL); null clears.

opportunityId.description: The change's key (e.g. ACME-12) or id, from compass_opportunities_list.

ownerPageId.description: PERSON page id who owns the work; null clears.

priority.description: How soon it matters; null clears it, and the map's suggestion shows again.

qualitativeNotes.description: Free-form notes (≤20,000 chars) — replaces the current notes.

tags.description: New tag set — replaces existing tags.

visibility.description: Who can see it: PRIVATE (only the user), WORKSPACE (every member, the default), or SHARED (specific people, granted afterwards). Say 'make it private' → PRIVATE.

workflowPageId.description: Workflow page to anchor to; null un-anchors.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: compass_opportunities_update
title: Edit an opportunity
